summary: Frontend-only security verification for BrandGuard (Next.js 15 client-only). Verified SEC-001 (ThreatNetwork tooltip HTML escape), hardening (ScamAnalyzer 2000-char cap on analyzeText + textarea maxLength), SEC-002 (security headers), and ran regression smoke across landing chips, link chips, dashboard stats, graph 2D/3D toggles, Scam Analyzer sample 10 for Zenvyra, Profiles investigate drawer + send-to-analyzer, and App Checker. All verifications pass.

security_verifications.SEC-001_tooltip_html_escape: PASS - esc() helper correctly escapes '' to '<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>'. Applied to node.label, node.score, and link.label in src/components/ThreatNetwork.jsx. 3D/2D graphs render and toggle without console errors.
security_verifications.SEC-002_security_headers: PASS - GET / returns: x-content-type-options: nosniff; referrer-policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin; permissions-policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=() (set in next.config.mjs).
security_verifications.scam_analyzer_dos_hardening: PASS - Even when bypassing DOM maxLength and injecting a 72,000-char string via value setter, analyzeText slices to 2000 chars (MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH) and returns scam-result in ~1.3s with no page freeze. Textarea maxLength=2000 attribute present on data-testid=scam-textarea.

regression_smoke.landing_zenvyra_chip: scanning-overlay shown, dashboard renders, stat-high-risk=5 (task note said 8 - seed count differs but functionality works)
regression_smoke.landing_paynest_chip: stat-high-risk=2 (task note said 4 - seed count differs)
regression_smoke.example-link-chip-paynest: opens Scam Analyzer and auto-analyzes successfully (scam-result = Fake Giveaway, 75% confidence)
regression_smoke.sample-chip-10_zenvyra: scam-type-badge='No scam indicators found' as expected
regression_smoke.profiles_investigate_drawer: investigate-btn-* opens profile-drawer; send-to-analyzer-<msgId> navigates to analyzer and auto-produces scam-result
regression_smoke.graph_toggles: graph-toggle-2d and graph-toggle-3d switch views with no console errors (only benign WebGL perf warnings and dev HMR websocket 502 which is preview-infra noise)

informational_notes: Task description expected stat-high-risk=8 for Zenvyra and 4 for Paynest; observed 5 and 2 respectively. Not touched per instruction 'Do not modify seed data or scoring logic'. Main agent may want to confirm whether task note is stale or seed/scoring changed.
Dev-only HMR WebSocket 502 warnings in console are expected behind the preview proxy and do not affect runtime.
ScamAnalyzer DOM maxLength prevents user typing/pasting >2000 chars; the server-side style defense (slice in analyzeText) correctly handles programmatic bypass.
critical_code_review_comments: ThreatNetwork tooltip still builds an HTML string (required by react-force-graph nodeLabel API). esc() is correctly applied to all interpolated values. Consider adding a unit-test for esc() to prevent future regressions.

ScamAnalyzer: DOM maxLength + analyzeText slice is good defense in depth. Consider also capping in extractEntities regex matching to avoid O(n) scans on extremely long inputs (current 2000 cap makes this moot but worth a comment).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Security audit fixes (SEC-001 HTML escape in ThreatNetwork tooltip, SEC-002 headers in next.config.mjs, ScamAnalyzer length cap) all verified via browser automation on the preview URL. If re-testing, reuse data-testids: example-chip-zenvyra/paynest, scanning-overlay, stat-high-risk, scam-textarea, analyze-btn, scam-result, sample-chip-10, nav-dashboard/profiles/scam/apps, graph-toggle-2d/3d, investigate-btn-*, profile-drawer, send-to-analyzer-*, app-official-a1.
